requirement: The author's explicit decision authorizes committing and pushing the reviewed footwear implementation and merging its source branch into Evenward main, superseding only the earlier main-merge prohibition.
acceptance: The integration record identifies the reviewed source commit, remote push, target main branch, and merge result without changing any production or Verified field.
negative: A green check authorizes an unreviewed merge, or the authorized source merge is described as a production release.
evidence: git commit, remote-ref, and merge transcript
supersession: supersedes only EVW-FP-AUTH-006's main-unlock prohibition and EVW-FP-RT-028's merge-ineligibility phrase after direct author authorization; release and production rules remain

requirement: A separate public GitHub repository named ShoeCareStudio may publish the bounded standalone extraction and may commit, push, and merge that reviewed source to its main branch independently of the Evenward-main operation.
acceptance: The public repository URL has the exact repository name ShoeCareStudio, visibility PUBLIC, and a merged reviewed main ref whose commit is recorded, whether or not the separately authorized Evenward merge has completed.
negative: A private, differently named, unmerged, untraceable, or Evenward-merge-dependent repository is reported as the requested public project.
evidence: GitHub repository metadata and ref transcript
supersession: adds independent author-approved public standalone distribution without changing production eligibility

requirement: Original ShoeCareStudio software is offered under PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0, with no repository-level license or metadata that grants commercial use; separable original documentation may use CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and third-party terms remain unchanged.
acceptance: The public repository contains the complete PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 terms, identifies that license in package and README metadata, maps separable documentation explicitly, and contains no conflicting permissive commercial-use grant for original software.
negative: The repository is labeled MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, generic open source, or otherwise grants commercial use to the original software.
evidence: license-file, package-metadata, README, and repository-license audit

locator: exact public metadata; unchanged claim boundary
requirement: The public repository description is exactly 'A local-first, accessibility-oriented pre-production leather shoe-care reference with fail-closed care semantics and a procedural Three.js renderer.'; topics are exactly leather-care, shoe-care, threejs, webgl, nextjs, react, typescript, accessibility, local-first, privacy, source-available, and noncommercial; no homepage is set until a standalone deployment exists.
acceptance: A GitHub metadata query returns the exact description, exact topic set, PUBLIC visibility, and an empty homepage, while the README says accessibility-oriented and pre-production without claiming conformance.
negative: Metadata says accessible or compliant, changes the description/topic set, advertises an undeployed homepage, or launders public visibility into a measured shoe finish.
evidence: GitHub description, topics, homepage, visibility, and README claim audit

requirement: Closed v1.0-v1.2 candidates, red-team reports, registers, deltas, and summaries remain byte-preserved; the ledger retains its pre-v1.3 bytes as an exact prefix, while the append-only ledger and active evidence map may receive additive v1.3 entries.
acceptance: Hard-coded hashes cover every closed footwear artifact through v1.2, the ledger begins with the hard-coded pre-v1.3 prefix, and v1.3 is exactly the canonical v1.2 register followed by the canonical integration delta.
negative: Earlier prohibition wording or a closed failed artifact is edited in place, the ledger prefix changes, or active additive evidence is incorrectly required to remain byte-static.
evidence: independent closed-artifact hashes, ledger-prefix check, and append-only composition test

requirement: Author-approved commit, push, merge, and public repository operations remain independent of canonical admission, release, deployment, compliance, inherited blockers, Verified status, and production unlock.
acceptance: The v1.3 summary retains 42 inherited blockers, zero Verified, and productionUnlocked false after all authorized repository operations succeed.
negative: A public repository, main-branch merge, GitHub success response, or green build reduces the blocker denominator or is reported as a production release.
evidence: register summary and post-integration claim audit
supersession: separates author-granted source integration from unchanged release and production gates

requirement: The final integration evidence joins the independently authorized Evenward and standalone operations by recording exact commit identities, target branches, push and merge outcomes, public URL, visibility, default branch, license, description, topics, and homepage without treating those repository facts as product acceptance evidence.
acceptance: A dated operational record independently resolves every enumerated field from git and GitHub after each applicable operation completes and repeats the zero-Verified production lock.
negative: Success is asserted from local intent, an unqueried remote, mutable UI recollection, dependence of one authorized operation on the other, or a repository fact substituted for missing physical, optical, accessibility, device, or independent-review evidence.
evidence: post-operation git and GitHub metadata transcript

requirement: The standalone package is named shoe-care-studio with display name ShoeCareStudio; it includes the care Studio/renderer, care state/store/material domains, focused footwear tests, register/evidence set, complete applicable noncommercial license suite, and only the minimal shell/styles/build configuration they require, while excluding Evenward trainer/avatar, chess, regulation-practice catalog, deployment configuration, and domains.
acceptance: A manifest and path audit finds every required care, test, register, evidence, and license surface; exact package/display names; no excluded Evenward product or deployment surface; and a passing standalone build and focused suite.
negative: A renamed full Evenward clone, incomplete care extraction, missing evidence/license surface, Evenward domain/deployment carryover, or mismatched package identity is published as ShoeCareStudio.
evidence: standalone manifest, path-denominator, build, and focused-test audit
